Results.ReviewText: Easy to assemble, and simple to use, once I got the hang of the photo directions. For me, it would have been even simpler with written instructions. I like the fact that there were very explicit instructions on how to test for gas leaks prior to "firing the unit up".
Results.Title: Handy

Results.ReviewText: This is a great little grill for traveling and tailgates. Simple and convenient design, no hassle cleanup, and very compact. My only complaint is that is doesn’t get very hot. Only up to like 350. I like to use this for football tailgates which can get well below the 30s. It’s hard to cook burgers, brats, or other meats in a timely manner when it’s that cold outside. I wish they made an insulated blanket for this like they do for other at-home grills. Maybe that’s something Weber will come out with in the future. I’d buy it! Other than that, love the grill!
Results.Title: Great grill! with ONE flaw

Results.ReviewText: Best little grill ever!  Our first Weber Q lasted approximately 20 years - The regulator went out on it, so we decided to update and got a new one.
Results.Title: Happy Grilling

Results.ReviewText: So far great grill. Perfect size for the two of us.
Results.Title: Sturdy Little Gril

Results.ReviewText: It is great at keeping a constant temperature. It can accommodate  a surprising amount of food.
Results.Title: Best little grill

Results.ReviewText: That it cooks precisely as indicated in the directions for heat and time. I had a problem initially with the valve regulator but I called, got a new part, and it works great!!

Results.ReviewText: Convenient for travel, camping, or tailgating. The biggest issue is you can not control the heat setting. If you cook cook on the lowest setting, the temperature will exceed 375 degrees or more. It will burn food too fast for proper cooking. I have switched out the gas regulator and still has the same results. Really too bad because Weber products are expected to far out perform other products. Considering how expensive this product is, you would expect the same high performance that you would expect for the price and a Weber product.
Results.Title: Burns way too hot.

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill. Unfortunately, the ignition assembly was first to corrode and stop working; I then began having problems with the grill bar lighting, even after cleaning the openings.  I contacted Weber and they immediately replaced not only the ignition assembly and grill bar, but the regulator as well.  Everything working like new!  Can't get any better service than that!
Results.Title: Weber is the Best

Results.ReviewText: I’ve actually had this grill for over two years now and I don’t know how I lived without it! It is convenient it is portable and for two people does a superb job! And since it’s a Weber, it is now a family member!
Results.Title: I’ve actually had this grill for over two years no

Results.ReviewText: We love, love this grill! We purchased the hose adapter to be able to use a large tank, which we will use most of the time, however we have some smaller tanks if we want to take the grill out to the lake or somewhere. The size is perfect to take to the front to grill, to the back or put in the car and take on an adventure! It cooks evenly and with the foldable sides it's nice having it as a place to set a plate or your grilling tools. I would recommend buying this for the multi-function purposes rather than some monster size grill, unless you are always cooking for a big group.
Results.Title: Love this small, but large enough Weber grill!

Results.ReviewText: This is my second grill, I purchased the first one back in 2013, my son is going to replace the regulator and control knob and he’s going to use it himself. Great product, the grates are top notch.
Results.Title: Q1200

Results.Title: Best Grill on the Market!

Results.ReviewText: Nicely designed...  a breeze to use and put away for the next time.

Just right for cooking for two or a quick snack. Heats up beautifully.
Tips:

Results.Title: TX RV Grill

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill. The grill cooks very nicely. The only issue I have with the grill is that using the fatter portable 1# tank is difficult. I managed to screw one into place after a lot of effort. It was a tight fit. The grill worked well and I left the tank in place but turned the gas valve on and off for cooking. I keep the grill in the garage and use it during winter months with my garage door open. The other day when I entered the garage. I could smell lpg!!! The tank had emptied itself because of it's tight fit against the grill handle thus applying excess pressure on the sealing from tank to control valve. A lot of the available portable tanks are like the one i had used. So.... the solution to be safe is purchasing a hose for 20# tank useage. No longer portable grill!!! Now have to use a large tank. Poor design of valve location. Weber messed up here.
Results.Title: Good purchase .

Results.ReviewText: This is the second small Weber we have bought for our camper - the first one, a Q1000, wound up being a permanent resident on our deck at home!  They are solid, sturdy, light easily, and are easy to cook on and clean.  The things I love on the new one are the split grill, the thermometer, and the fold out side shelves. It may wind up being the permanent deck resident with the older Q1000 going in the camper!
Results.Title: Love This Small Grill

Results.ReviewText: Really like the new grill, but prefer the whole grill instead of the grill broken into two sections.
Results.Title: New Grill

Also does a great job on low heat plus the wind doesn’t seem to affect it much due to the cover.
Great easy to clean drip pan.

I'm delighted!
